yaw.official_score: directionally correct non-zero visual/action responses divided by all contract-valid declared intervention pairs
yaw.material_response_score: directionally correct detected visual response divided by all material-action pairs

progress.reason: DriveWAM same-source progress response is near random and full-four-interval pair coverage is low

claim_boundary: RCS measures whether visual and native-action changes co-respond to the same controlled command intervention. It does not prove that the action trajectory causally controls video generation.
